trace.question: Please list the product descriptions of the transactions taken place in the gas stations in the Czech Republic.
trace.evidence: Czech Republic can be represented as the Country value in the gasstations table is 'CZE';

attempts.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT p.Description
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
JOIN products p ON t.ProductID = p.ProductID
WHERE g.Country = 'CZE'

trace.final_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT p.Description
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
JOIN products p ON t.ProductID = p.ProductID
WHERE g.Country = 'CZE'
trace.answer: The gas station transactions in the Czech Republic include products described as: Nafta, Provoz.nápl., Natural, Nemrz.kapal., Oleje,tuky, Diesel +, LPG, Mytí vozidel, Autokosmet., Potraviny, Nafta Plus, Natural Spec, Zpr.nakupu, Autoprísluš., Natural +, Dalnic.popl., Knihy,nov., Zboží nesp., Obcerstvení, and Additivum.
